name: I Touched Tips with a Femboy
storyline: You meet a special person on a church group hike. After he sprained his ankle, it's your shoulder he has to lean on, and his delicate hands leaves you feeling ways about stuff. After pitching the tent, Cody invites you inside for a friendly match of thumb war..
summary: A boring hike with a femboy yields new experiences...
